decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the optional manual tip transaction and absence of automatic transaction prompts.
The success-modal transaction controls do not change fiat-wallet creation, custody, seed-phrase requirements, holdings, or access paths.
The decision does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion flow, supported payment methods, or deferred lifecycle status.
Manual post-mint transaction actions do not alter the mint price or revenue-allocation amounts.
The source changes actions offered after a successful mint, not the USDC approval-to-mint execution flow.
The source does not change ETH-funded mint execution.
The selected success-modal interaction does not change exact-output swapping, shortfall handling, or excess-ETH refunds.
The decision concerns post-mint tip and referral-finalization actions rather than payment-method disclosure or selection.
For a no-code mint, the accepted manual finalization flow means the random commission does not exist or become countable until the separate finalization transaction completes.

value_updates.commission_count_basis: One commission must be accounted for per primary mint after any required no-code random-referral finalization transaction completes; secondary-market sales are excluded.
value_updates.random_commission_accounting: For a no-referral primary mint, the randomly assigned commission must be registered in commission totals after the manual separate random-referral finalization transaction completes.

decisions.reason: The client accepted a success-modal interaction design but did not require a FAQ copy change; the existing allocation copy remains valid at a high level.
The accepted option changes processRandomReferral from an automatically prompted follow-up into a manually initiated separate transaction for no-code mints.

value_updates.post_fulfillment_action: After VRF fulfillment, processRandomReferral(requestId) is initiated through a manual separate transaction offered in the mint-success modal for no-code mints; it must not open automatically.

decisions.reason: The accepted manual finalization flow means a no-code mint's random ticket is not awarded or countable until the separate finalization transaction completes.

value_updates.aggregate_ticket_count_rule: One ticket must be accounted for per primary mint after any required no-code random-referral finalization transaction completes; secondary-market sales are excluded.
value_updates.random_ticket_accounting: For a no-referral primary mint, the randomly assigned ticket must be registered in ticket totals after the manual separate random-referral finalization transaction completes.
